task: Join `ad_placement_performance_tracking_2024.xlsx` with `channel_placement_data_2024q4.xlsx` and `all_channels_placement_budget_allocation_2024.xlsx` so that each channel shows budget, actual spend and return. Rank the channels by efficiency and flag any channel spending well above its allocation. Where a channel is efficient but small, say so explicitly rather than ranking it alongside the large ones, since efficiency at low volume rarely survives being scaled up and a ranking that ignores volume will send the budget to the wrong place.
